notes: Room is simulated (RC model) on real Astana weather from Open-Meteo; forecast error from LightGBM on ThermBuild test data.

alert.title: Overheating soon
alert.body: The room will pass 24 °C in 120 min. Keep the window closed: SmartHeat turns the radiator down.

advice.title: Overheating expected
advice.text: Without action the room passes 24 °C in about 120 min. SmartHeat is turning the radiator valve down to keep 22 °C.

advice.title: Keep the window closed
advice.text: Opening the window to cool an overheated room throws the heat outside. Let the valve reduce the heating instead.

advice.title: Ventilate briefly
advice.text: For fresh air, open the window wide for 5 minutes instead of keeping it ajar for hours.

advice.title: Night mode
advice.text: At night 20-21 °C is enough for good sleep and saves heat.

assumptions: Room ~20 m2 in a panel building, envelope UA 25 W/K, infiltration 9 W/K
Radiator sized to hold ~22 C at the design outdoor temperature (Astana -31.2 C, Baku -4 C)
Supply curve 95 C at design temperature, 40 C at +8 C, never below 60 C in mild weather (range 55-65)
Without system: valve always open, window opened above 24 C, closed below 22 C
With SmartHeat: window kept closed, valve throttled when the 1-hour forecast exceeds 22 C
Forecast error equals the LightGBM 1-hour error measured on ThermBuild test data
Heating season: 5-day mean outdoor temperature at or below +10 C (Astana) / +8 C (Baku)
CO2: coal (IPCC other bituminous, 94.6 t CO2/TJ), generation efficiency 0.85, network losses excluded
CO2: natural gas (IPCC, 56.1 t CO2/TJ), generation efficiency 0.90, network losses excluded
